name: Italy: Central and Southern Italy

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will understand and recognize the regions of Central and Southern Italy and be able to match grape varieties to major DOC/DOCGs.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will know the DOC/DOCGs in Central and Southern Italy, match grape varieties to their regions, and understand winemaking styles.

rows.intro: Extends from the Ligurian Sea in the west to the foothills of the Apennine Mountains in the east.

Central:; Umbria: Sagrantino di Montefalco DOCG; Marche; Abruzzo: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC; Southern:; Campania: Taurasi DOCG, Greco di Tufo DOCG, Fiano di Avellino DOCG; Puglia; Basilicata; Calabria
rows.certified: Identify all major regions of Central and Southern Italy on a map.; Marche: Verdicchio di Matelica DOC, Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC

rows.intro: Central: Maritime on the coast and Continental inland.; South: Mediterranean

rows.certified: Ligurian Sea, Tyrrhenian Sea, Adriatic Sea, Mt. Vesuvius
Match DOCG to Major Region:; Campania: Taurasi DOCG, Greco di Tufo DOCG, Fiano di Avellino DOCG; Marche: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC, Verdicchio di Matelica DOC

rows.intro: Superiore: Higher alcohol level requirement; Riserva: Longer aging requirements

rows.certified: Know producers, cuvées, and vintages if you recommend them in the Hospitality and Service Exam.
Young Taurasi and Sagrantino di Montefalco should be decanted.
